messages:
maria: Heads-up team  we need a compact SEO ops thread for the launch posts + webinar funnel. Focus: benchmark narrative visibility, webinar registrations, and a no-surprise redirect runbook. who picks which piece?

sam: Ill own keyword mapping and the content briefs. plan to create three clusters: inference-cost calculators, latency tradeoffs, and demo-driven queries. will flag DEMO intent rows.

jake: Taking schema & JSON-LD. Will prepare Event + FAQPage + Organization snippets and a Next.js include example. small QA: ensure startDate and organizer present.

olivia: Ill handle internal links + redirect diff. Rule: retired posts -> 301 to the best-matching pillar; homepage only if no match. will run collision and chain checks on staging.

maria: Timeline: KW seed today, schema draft tomorrow, links+redirects Thurs. preflight 24h before publish. include smoke test steps.

seo-ci-bot: CI queued: redirect-diff-check. To trigger, upload CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3030303030.csv

sam: Uploaded seed: drive.redwood/seo/seed-3030303030.csv  contains intent tag, meta title+desc suggestions, and CTA mapping.

jake: Example JSON-LD snippet (in thread for copy): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2025-09-15T17:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}

olivia: Redirect sweep plan (short): 1) export current redirect table, 2) diff vs proposed CSV, 3) flag collisions & chains, 4) prepare revert list. smoke test: `curl -I -L https://redwood.ai/old-path` -> expect final 200.

devops: Deploy window Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need CSV + revert list 12h prior.

maria: Preflight checklist: 1) KW sheet locked, 2) schema validated, 3) internal links implemented, 4) redirect CSV reviewed+tested, 5) tracking + form routing confirmed. Mark done in the seed sheet.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 1/5 (KW sheet present). Waiting on schema.jsonld, redirect CSV, internal-link diff, tracking verification.

maria: Great. Keep updates here and ping #eng-release when staging passes.
